text: Welcome to Gladiator Version 3
Press h to get help while in
the game.  The help page will
describe the keys used in the
game.  This text will be used
at the beginning of each
scenario to let you know where
you are and what you should be
doing.  And so we enter the
world of Gladiator, and the
life of a young new combatant.
Diary Entry 73
We are camped near the forest
of Talwood, bordering Talos
lake.  We are preparing to
move north to the city of
Talwood, but we know we face
the Talwood elves on our way.
The elves have been blocking
travel through the forest
of late, for no known reason.
Our commander thinks our
force will be sufficient to
break through, but I am not
so sure, and rumor has it
that the edge of the forest
is littered with the corpses
of those who have tried the
crossing.  We will be
marching soon.
